positive_law: The whole image is assembled from many small discrete units governed by a visible local ordering rule. People, environment and relationships emerge from how units cluster, align and change rule rather than from smooth drawing. Human specificity comes from distinct local unit rhythm and body-scale organization. Consequence is a persistent local rule change propagated through the field by an earlier human action.

axes.representation ontology: discrete repeated units whose local ordering collectively forms people and environment
axes.spatial/relational organization: field-scale rhythm, clustering, directional alignment and local rule transitions organize proximity and relationship
axes.figure-ground/material-edge grammar: unit boundaries remain perceivable; larger figures emerge from coordinated module behavior rather than continuous contour or wash
axes.human identity/specificity mechanism: each person has a distinct module cadence, orientation mix, density and posture-scale organization while sharing the same unit vocabulary
axes.consequence/history representation: an earlier human act produces a persistent local ordering change that propagates or terminates through neighboring units and alters present affordance/relationship
axes.tonal/texture/atmosphere construction: structured granular field with value emerging statistically from module density/orientation rather than painterly residue or smooth gradients

anti_motif: Do not reduce the premise to decorative pattern, pixel art, map symbols or a diagrammatic grid; the unit rule must create a compelling whole visual world with specific people.
expected_failure_modes: rule change becomes an explanatory symbol rather than present condition
construction_exclusions: current C0/O3/TYP/MAT/STA/MOT/CLR mechanisms as construction ingredients
historical exact VID/hero/Quiet Stage/Mineral Theater surfaces
brand marks, names, UI, wordmark, bespoke typography, product semantics, functional iconography, motion scoring, final palette selection
renderer_translation_law: Translate only the positive whole-surface premise law and the applicable neutral content packet into renderer-visible prose. Do not include this premise's expected failure modes, contamination notes, project vocabulary or comparison criteria.
